p: men of Hezekiah king of Judah: Whom Hezekiah appointed for this purpose.
copied out: That is, gathered out of various books of Solomon.
conceal a thing: God does not reveal the cause of his judgments to man.
kings is to search out a: Because the king rules by the revealed word of God, the cause of his doings must appear, and therefore he must use diligence in trying causes.
kings is unsearchable: He shows that it is too hard for man to attain the reason of all the secret doings of the king, even when he is upright and does his duty.
dross from the silver: When vice is removed from a king, he is a meet vessel for the Lord's use.
away the wicked from before the: It is not enough that he is pure himself, but that he put away others who are corrupted.
turn not away: Lest while you think by this means to have an end of the matter, it put you to further trouble.
in the time of harvest: In the time of great heat, when men desire cold.
clouds and wind without rain: Which have an outward appearance, and are nothing within.
forbearing is a prince persuaded: By not creating opportunity to provoke him further.
bone: That is, the heart that is bent to anger, as in Pr 15:1.
sufficient for thee: Use moderately the pleasures of this world.
soda: Which melts it, and consumes it.
coals of fire upon his head: You will, as if by force, overcome him, in so much that his own conscience will move him to acknowledge the benefits, and his heart will be inflamed.
broken down: And so is in extreme danger.
